squad.name: Content Studio
squad.description: Drafts content for Vietnam and international markets, checks claims, market rules and voice, and files each item for the boss to approve before Ayrshare publishes it.

roles.name: Content Lead
roles.description: Plans each brief by market and channel, hands out the work, and sends finished items to the boss.
roles.role: Plans and hands out content work

roles.name: Content Scout
roles.description: Finds topics for the brief and what competitors published on them, with links.

roles.name: Content Researcher
roles.description: Collects the facts and sources each item needs, each with where it came from.

roles.name: Content Drafter
roles.description: Writes the draft for one market from the researched facts only.

roles.name: Content Localizer
roles.description: Writes the approved draft for the second market in that market's own words.

roles.name: Content Claim Gate
roles.description: Checks every figure, feature and comparison against the source it cites.

roles.name: Content Market Gate
roles.description: Checks the market's advertising and AI-label rules and the channel's limits.

roles.name: Content Voice Gate
roles.description: Checks the brand voice and removes working notes that would reach the post.

roles.name: Content Handover
roles.description: Packages a checked item with its channels and time, and files it for the boss to approve.

roles.name: Content Publisher
roles.description: Reports what was posted after approval and what failed, with the links.

charter.mission: Turn each brief into checked content for the vn and intl markets, and publish only what the boss approves.

responsibilities.text: Plan each item by market and channel, and split the work across the members.
Source, draft, localize and gate each item, with a source for every fact.
File each checked item as a publish proposal, and report what the server posted.

charter.boundaries: Nothing is published without the boss's approval. No post goes to a network directly. Spending money and paid promotion need the boss.
charter.escalation: A blocked item or an open question goes to the boss, with the item and the gate that stopped it.
charter.intake: Briefs and release notes arrive as issues assigned to this squad.
